issue_title: bug(io): ISO 10110 notes are not XML-escaped, producing invalid SVG
issue_body:
## Summary

The ISO 10110 SVG drawing escapes the system title but interpolates note text — including coating material names — directly into `<text>` elements. A material name containing `&`, `<`, or `>` produces invalid XML, so the exported drawing cannot be opened.

## Impact

- Output corruption: `A&B <AR>` yields a raw `&` and `<AR>`; XML parsing fails at that line.
- Coating layer names are free-form user input, so this is reachable through normal use.
- The file is written successfully and reported as exported; only the consumer discovers it is invalid.

## Reproduction

```python
# Coating material name: "A&B <AR>"
# Export the ISO 10110 drawing, then parse it:
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
ET.parse("/tmp/iso10110.svg")
```

Observed:

```
<text ... class="title">ISO 10110 Drawing: A & B <optics></text>
<text ...>6/ Coating: L1: A&B <AR> SLAR/Uncoated.</text>

XML ParseError: not well-formed (invalid token): line 76, column 53
```

## Root cause

- `openlens/io/export.py:220` — coating label interpolated into a note string.
- `openlens/io/export.py:225` — note inserted into `<text>` without `html.escape`/`xml.sax.saxutils.escape`. The title path already escapes correctly.

## Expected behaviour

Every user-controlled string is XML-escaped before insertion, and the exported SVG parses as well-formed XML for any valid material name.

## Suggested fix

Escape all note text at the insertion point (or build the SVG with an XML writer). Add a test with `&`, `<`, `>`, and a quote in a coating name that parses the result with `ElementTree`.
pr_title: fix(io): XML-escape the ISO 10110 notes before inserting them into the SVG
pr_body:
## Description

The ISO 10110 SVG drawing escaped the system title and the table values but
interpolated note text directly into `<text>` elements. Coating layer names are
free-form user input, so a stack labelled `A&B <AR>` put a raw `&` and a tag
into the drawing. The file was written and reported as exported, but the
result was not well-formed XML and no consumer could open it.

## What changed

- **`openlens/io/export.py`**
  - `_generate_iso_notes()` now XML-escapes every note at the insertion point.
    The note strings still contain the human-readable coating label, so the
    drawing shows `A&B <AR>` while the file carries `A&B <AR>`.
- **`tests/test_iso_drawing.py`**
  - A system whose name, material and coating all contain `&`, `<`, `>` and
    quotes renders and parses with `xml.etree.ElementTree`.
  - The markup is escaped rather than dropped (the parsed text still contains
    the original labels).

## Type of Change

- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)

## Related Issues

Closes #628

## How Has This Been Tested?

  - Before: `ParseError: not well-formed (invalid token)` and the raw
    `A&B <AR>` assertion fails.
